Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Rishabh - 12 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Isha - 11 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
3. Anita - 39 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
4. Manoj - 45 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The garden - flower beds, a mango tree
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Rishabh stands in the living room. Isha, Anita and Manoj stand near him.]

Anita: "What lovely weather!"

[Rishabh combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Rishabh (laughing): "Isha, look at this."

[Rishabh puts on his shoes and ties the laces.]

Anita (laughing): "One more time!"

[Isha puts on red lipstick.]

Isha (softly): "That's easy."

Scene 2: The garden - Day

Anita: "So, here we are!"

[Rishabh waters the plants.]

Rishabh: "Show me too!"

[Rishabh chases a butterfly in the garden.]

Rishabh: "How beautiful!"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

Manoj: "What a nice place."

[Rishabh climbs the stairs to the terrace.]

Rishabh: "I knew it!"

[Rishabh hides behind the tree.]

Anita: "What next?"

[Rishabh searches for his lost ball.]

Rishabh (laughing): "What a day to remember!"
